title: team-matrix e2e restore of remote objects dir races a concurrent writer (ENOTEMPTY on macOS)
observation: The team-matrix e2e test moves memory.git/objects to objects.transiently-unavailable to simulate a transient remote failure, then moves it back in a finally block. On macOS CI (PR #422 run 36000074912, job 107634731124, 2026-09-24) the move back failed with ENOTEMPTY: something (likely a background sync or push from one of the MCP clients) recreated memory.git/objects during that window. This is a test-fixture race, not product code. The code under test in #422 (MCP tool profile) is unrelated. Possibly the same root cause as the intermittent Windows test-67 flake fnd_8bdf9841a3. Candidate fix: on restore, merge any recreated objects/ into the saved dir (objects are content-addressed), then remove it and rename; or quiesce clients before the rename.
